rules: Reference fixture names, dates, owners, cases and totals are never inserted into runtime state or API payloads.
Client identity, closed-case relation, finance values, contact values and history derive from existing workspace-scoped sources.
Existing edit, new-case, restore/navigation, activity and client navigation owners remain the behavior boundary; no parallel mutation flow was added.

All trash/delete icons continue to resolve through the canonical --cf-vst-color-delete family.
